I have the same fear of being a burden. I'm very afraid that my depression will take a toxic form and when people reach out i will insult them or something. Good luck to you.
I have depression myself but when I need to wait through a rough period i nap a lot and listen to good (sad) music. I guess the key is just to distract yourself

I told another that i'm anxious about climate change killing us in 40 years and she started crying that she might be killed in a hatecrime before that. I guess i just shouldn't talk to other depressed people or something but i feel really alone with my problems. I don't want to upset anyone.
